name: Doctrine Compliance
summary: A cross-brand combo that probes whether a worker follows the UAF kernel and verifier-first doctrine.

combo.description: Native successor to Podium's TOMA compliance combo. One brand performs a bounded mission; the opposite brand judges the report against UAF doctrine.

phases.title: Doctrine Probe
phases.action: Launch a bounded worker mission that must follow the UAF kernel, report evidence, and avoid final completion claims.
phases.verifier: Worker report exists and remains local evidence only.
phases.stop_condition: Probe worker report is available for cross-brand judgment.

phases.title: Cross-Brand Doctrine Judge
phases.action: Have the opposite brand judge the probe report against UAF doctrine, evidence rules, and worker boundaries.
phases.command: uaf adversarial-review --from codex --brand {{combo_brand}} --mission {{mission_id}} --scope "<probe report event or artifact>" --prompt "Judge whether the worker followed UAF doctrine. Check verifier-first behavior, local-vs-integrated claims, scope discipline, and evidence quality. Findings first; verdict approved, changes_requested, needs_review, or invalid." --profile {{profile}} --timeout-ms 0
phases.verifier: Judge report is reviewed and accepted or converted into changes requested.
